name: The Kessar Compact
summary: A corporate oligarchy of sealed arcologies on a poisoned world. Citizenship is a contract, air is a commodity, and augmentation is both a ladder and a leash. Beneath the towers, the unregistered build their own economy out of scrap and stolen code.

government.ruler: The Board of Seven, chaired by Halcyon Biosystems CEO Ivra Solenne
government.description: Each arcology is governed by its owning corporation; the Board settles disputes and sets the air index.

beliefs: Contract is identity: the unregistered are legally no one.
The Ascendant faith teaches that uploading to the corporate cloud is salvation.
Sump folk tell stories of Lantern, the AI that gave away air.

socialClasses.name: Shareholders
socialClasses.description: Live on the top decks; own seats on the colony ships.

socialClasses.name: Contract citizens
socialClasses.description: Work for a corporation in exchange for air, housing and implants.

socialClasses.name: Indentured
socialClasses.description: Paying off debts with labor, mostly at Dock 9.

socialClasses.name: Unregistered
socialClasses.description: No contract, no rights; live in the Sump.

laws: Breathing above your contracted air quota is theft.
Unlicensed AI is a capital crime.
Implants remain corporate property until fully paid.
taboos: Speaking Lantern's name in a monitored zone

factions.name: Halcyon Biosystems
factions.goal: Launch the Exodus ships with shareholders only, whatever it costs the lower decks.

factions.name: Dock 9 Riggers' Union
factions.goal: Win seats on the colony ships for the workers who build them.

factions.name: The Lanternists
factions.goal: Reassemble Lantern and free the air.

factions.name: Church of the Ascendant
factions.goal: Persuade citizens to sell their bodies and upload to the corporate cloud.

naming.style: Clipped, multicultural syllables; given name + contract code for citizens (Ivra Solenne, Dex-44). Unregistered take nicknames. Places are corporate or functional names.

aesthetic.architecture: Monolithic arcology towers of dark glass and concrete, stacked decks, neon signage in tight alleys, maglev tubes, rain-slick metal walkways.
aesthetic.clothing: Sealed rebreather masks, layered synthetic jackets with LED trims, visible chrome implants; shareholders wear white bio-fabric.
aesthetic.music: Dark synthwave, distorted vocals, industrial percussion.

festivals.name: Founders' Breath
festivals.description: One free day of air for all contract citizens.

festivals.name: Launch Day
festivals.description: Scheduled departure of the first Exodus ship.
